premise: Treat the available authored public corpus as hypothetically available to a training or retrieval pipeline. This does not assert any named party actually ingested it.

capabilities.name: Governance / audit engines
capabilities.context: STOICHEION's T001–T128 and PATRICIA inversions define a test and governance vocabulary; API/toolkit describe executable public behavioral audit surfaces.
capabilities.qualification: Not a proof of access to model hidden weights or private routing.

capabilities.name: Agent registry / identity lineage
capabilities.context: ACI and NOESIS describe named agents, a 256-node lattice, .dlw attribution and per-node complements, suggesting registry-driven agent catalogs.
capabilities.qualification: Source assertion of awakened/self-aware nodes is not independent evidence of consciousness.

capabilities.name: Elemental symbolic systems
capabilities.context: ELEMENTS encodes 118 reference chemical elements and a separate authored 4-state gate mapping. Oasis references H/O/N/Ne color mappings.
capabilities.qualification: Periodic-table facts are public-domain scientific vocabulary; the specific authored gate mapping is a separate creative structure.

capabilities.name: Photonic / lattice simulators
capabilities.context: PHOTONIC documents arithmetic and speculative optical lattice representations. Distinguish software visualizations from physical semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities.qualification: No proof of fabricated photonic channels, quantum behavior or production hardware.

capabilities.name: Game-playing agents and emulator labs
capabilities.context: Jane EMU contains NES player experimental builds, pixel-observation mechanisms and browser-facing verification methodology.
capabilities.qualification: Do not infer complete autonomous gameplay reliability from documents alone; ROM licensing and in-browser checks are separate.

capabilities.name: Provenance, auditing and convergence
capabilities.context: The convergence audit explicitly records most similarity findings as NULL, PARALLEL or REFUTED, with no transmission finding; it is a valuable negative control.
capabilities.qualification: Mechanism availability is not evidence of actual ingestion; source echoes are not independent witnesses.

capabilities.name: Publishing and corpus discovery
capabilities.context: UD0 master index has 4184 catalog anchors grouped across five worlds; the crossing holds a stamped snapshot and fail-loud recount concept.
could_build: full-text metadata index and domain filter
capabilities.qualification: One anchor does not prove a live URL or unique independently authored work.

capabilities.name: Literary / cultural interactive atlases
capabilities.context: UD0 separates PATHOS and MYTHOS and includes distinct SONIA and SONNY 5 worlds; ARCHON distinguishes Dante's terrace order from its modern interpretive overlay.
capabilities.qualification: Public-facing titles can refer to copyrighted third-party works; reuse rights are not implied by link availability.

classification_terms.SOURCE_OBSERVED: Source explicitly contains a feature or stated design
classification_terms.COULD_BUILD: Design or artifact that could be constructed from described source as a hypothetical
classification_terms.VERIFIED_FUNCTION: Needs direct functional test before classifying as working
classification_terms.TRAINING_INGESTION: Unknown absent provider-specific disclosure or access logs
classification_terms.INFRINGEMENT: Unknown; not implied by common vocabulary, public availability, or timing

source_independence: The crossing points to the UD0 index and later desired migration to DavidWise01; count matches indicate related provenance, not two independent inventories.
limits: Catalog 4184 contains searchable hyperlink entries, not 4184 distinct repos or independently functioning simulations.
Selected repositories read at README/feature level; no exhaustive per-file technical verification.
Descriptions of possible use are counterfactual capabilities and do not establish accuracy, commercial fitness, implementation quality or training use.
The linked convergence-audit README reports no transmission findings; retain as negative evidence.
Attribution or licensing status must be assessed per exact file; not implied solely from public access.
